title: What If You Spent 1 Hour in the World's Quietest Room? 🤫 #Shorts
description: What happens if you sit in the world's quietest room for one hour? At negative 20.6 decibels, your brain turns ear sensitivity to maximum. You hear your blood whooshing, your heartbeat like a sledgehammer, and by minute 45, you hallucinate phantom voices!
